# Field Operations

A **sample note** for previewing the theme. These entries are examples, not new campaign canon.

## Mission briefing

The winter air is cold and still. A ruined service road leads toward a shuttered maintenance station.

> [!quest] Restore the signal
> Locate the control room, assess the damage, and decide whether to bring the transmitter online.

> [!location] Maintenance station
> A locked service entrance and a collapsed loading bay offer two approaches.

> [!warning] Unstable floor
> Heavy machinery has weakened the walkway. Describe the warning signs before anyone crosses.

### At the table

- [ ] Describe the approach.
- [ ] Ask which entrance the players use.
- [x] Prepare the location notes.

| Route | Advantage | Complication |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Service entrance | Cover from the road | Locked door |
| Loading bay | Easy access | Exposed approach |
| Roof hatch | Clear view | Damaged ladder |

> [!loot]- Supply cache
> A sealed toolkit, a worn map, and a handwritten maintenance log.

> [!radiation] Contaminated storage
> A damaged container sits behind the shelving. Establish the hazard before resolving exposure using your normal rules.
